title: IonQ Named A Market Shaper In Gartner's Quantum Computing Report
excerpt: IonQ is named a Market Shaper in the inaugural Gartner Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing, recognized for reliably delivering systems.
content:
IonQ has been identified as a “Market Shaper” in the inaugural Gartner Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing, a designation reserved for vendors considered “low-risk, high-impact leaders” in the field. The report recognizes IonQ’s ability to reliably deliver advanced quantum systems for commercial use, coinciding with a potential $300 million advance to Stage C of DARPA’s Quantum Benchmarking Initiative this October.

“We’re honored by this recognition from Gartner,” said Niccolo de Masi, Chairman and CEO of IonQ. “We feel this is a significant validation of what our team has built.” This assessment positions IonQ as a leader in a rapidly evolving quantum ecosystem, with systems now deployed at institutions including Florida International University and NVIDIA’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center.

This categorization, detailed in the report, positions IonQ as a comparatively low-risk investment for organizations seeking transformative quantum technologies. Gartner defines Market Shapers as “low-risk, high-impact leaders” within the nascent quantum market, acknowledging their proven ability to support systems in real-world deployments. The report’s assessment arrives as IonQ expands its quantum computing services, currently accessible via all major cloud providers since 2021, and extends its reach into networking and sensing applications across diverse environments.

IonQ notes that quantum computing has moved into accelerating real world use cases and commercial deployment. IonQ’s headquarters, located in College Park, Maryland, oversees operations spanning North America, Latin America, EMEA and the APAC region, indicating a broad geographic footprint.

The company’s ambitions extend beyond simply offering computing power. They are actively building what they describe as the quantum ecosystem and setting industry standards. “We believe IonQ is building the quantum ecosystem and setting the industry standard,” de Masi added, emphasizing the company’s vision for a comprehensive quantum infrastructure.

Earlier systems have helped customers and partners including Web Services and AstraZeneca achieve a 20x performance increase over previous quantum solutions and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

IonQ’s Superion Systems Demonstrate 20x Performance & 99.99% Fidelity

Superion systems from IonQ delivered a 20x performance increase over prior quantum solutions, accelerating innovation across multiple sectors including drug discovery and materials science, according to the company. The Gartner report states, “Market Shapers have proven their ability to reliably deliver and support cutting-edge systems in commercial environments, making them generally less risky bets for technology buyers seeking transformation.” The company’s Superion systems are currently being used by partners including Web Services and AstraZeneca, further solidifying its position as a key player in the development of practical quantum applications.
